thread:
tariq: Kicking off RC creation for v2.9.0-rc3. Changes: kv-cache fix, embedding service migration, small users schema tweak. Target change window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PST. Please ack pin + canary plan. release notes: https://go/redwood/relnotes/2.9.0-rc3

sarah: acked. Noted DB migration will take a ~2m lock on shard 3, will schedule at low-traffic point.

owen: I can sheriff the window 09:00-13:00 PST. Recommend prebake KV warm for 10m before shifting traffic.

maya: release notes LGTM. FYI there's a perf test flake I fixed on main that made it into this candidate.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: artifact sha=abc1234789. Pin requested by tariq. To reserve artifact: `/deploy pin 2.9.0-rc3`

tariq: Pin requested — can someone run the pin and confirm? Proposing canary rollout: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if green. Rollback thresholds: p50 > 120ms or errors > 1%.

owen: /deploy pin done, artifact pinned. Confirmed.

oncall-bot: Oncall rota updated: owen assigned 09:00-13:00 PST.

maya: Quick rollback plan in ops runbook: if triggers fire, run emergency rollback job to 2.8.9. I'll paste commands here.

tariq: rollback snippet:
```bash
redwood rollback --from 2.9.0-rc3 --to 2.8.9 --force
```

sarah: Added smoke eval hooks: prometheus alerts and an automated eval suite against prompt set `critical-reads`.

owen: I'll watch KV warm logs. Ping me if tokenq backlog > 200k or store-miss rate > 8%.

deploy-bot: Promo scheduled in window at 09:05 PST. Canary automation will execute steps. Operator approval required: y/n?

tariq: y

owen: Starting canary now — kicking off prebake.

maya: Prebake completed: KV hit-rate 92%, cache fill looks healthy.

deploy-bot: Canary (5%) started. Initial metrics: lat p50=85ms, error rate=0.12%.

sarah: Smoke eval passed, no regression in top-10 prompts.

tariq: Hold for 15m, then promote to 25% unless alerts.

owen: 15m check — metrics stable. Promoting to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion applied. Current traffic: 25%. Will hold and monitor for 30m before full rollout.

tariq: Thanks — leaving thread open for post-promo notes. I'll update final release notes and the changelog once we clear the full rollout. :tada:
